pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H 'Cổng Mặt Trời' cao 126 m: hai cột đứng (mặt trong ốp gò đồng đỏ, mặt ngoài bê tông), dầm ngang dạng vòm cổng (vòm trên chữ U, vòm dưới cổng chào), chân trụ tách đôi
pylons_en: 2 'Sun Gate' H pylons, 126 m: two vertical posts (copper-clad red inner faces, concrete outside) joined by an arched gate (U above, portal arch below); each post splits into two legs at the base

pylon_custom.description: 'Cổng Mặt Trời' H pylon: two vertical posts rising free to flat tips, copper-clad (red) on their inner faces and concrete outside; between them a red gate whose upper edge is a deep U hanging from high on the posts to ≈28 m above the deck and whose lower edge is a round-headed arch over the carriageway (crown ≈23 m); below ≈21 m above the deck each post splits along the bridge into two splayed concrete legs down to a rectangular pile cap.
